prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, depicting the interior of a lush botanical greenhouse. On the far left, a tall fern in a terracotta pot stands beside a woman in a yellow raincoat who is kneeling on the stone floor. Next to her, a small tabby cat sits calmly, watching a blue watering can that rests near its paws. In the center foreground, an old wooden bench holds a man in a tweed cap who is reading a thick book. Beside him on the bench, a woven basket overflows with white lilies. Standing directly behind the bench, a child in striped socks points excitedly at a large monstera leaf hanging from above. To the right of the child, a gardener in green overalls hands a pair of shears to a woman in a floral dress. She accepts the tool while looking at a pruning wound on a nearby rose bush. Perched on the rim of a large clay planter on the right side, a parrot with red feathers observes the scene. Below the parrot, a sleeping brown dog lies curled up on a rug. Leaning against the glass wall in the background, a ladder reaches toward the ceiling beams. A hanging orchid in a suspended wire basket dangles just above the ladder's top rung. Near the back door, a boy in a blue shirt looks at a butterfly resting on a leaf. The butterfly flutters its wings slightly as the boy watches. There is no electric lighting fixture visible in the ceiling structure. There is no modern plastic signage on any of the plant displays.
